inclusions.text: Private, air-conditioned vehicle with a professional driver
inclusions.source: Every crossing is in a private, air-conditioned vehicle with a professional driver, and includes one bottle of mineral water per person.

inclusions.text: One bottle of mineral water per person
inclusions.source: Every crossing is in a private, air-conditioned vehicle with a professional driver, and includes one bottle of mineral water per person.

inclusions.text: Pick-up from your Hurghada hotel or address
inclusions.source: Pick-up is from your Hurghada hotel or address.

inclusions.text: Drop-off at your Luxor hotel (Standard Transfer)
inclusions.source: The Standard Transfer is a clean, direct proposition: private vehicle, professional driver, water, and a drop-off at your Luxor hotel.

inclusions.text: Company representative who manages luggage and handles check-in (Assisted Transfer)
inclusions.source: The Assisted Transfer adds a company representative who manages luggage, accompanies you for the full crossing, and handles check-in at the other end — useful if you are travelling with elderly family members, young children, or simply prefer not to navigate an unfamiliar arrival alone.
The crossing requires a road permit, obligatory under local authority rules and included in the transfer price, along with tolls and fuel.

exclusions.source: As a transfer, it does not include a guide.
